summary.text: Michael McVicker is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Randy Bridges (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a working-class father and campaigned on labor rights, early education and housing affordability.

paragraphs.text: McVicker said in a Ballotpedia survey that his campaign centers on strengthening labor rights, including repealing Kentucky's right-to-work law.
He also listed pre-K for all, paid family leave and housing affordability as priorities, and called for requiring fiscal notes to be public before a bill is voted on.

sources.title: Michael McVicker - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
